meta.label: Synchronize datasets across branches
meta.description: Compare dataset types and storage locations with a selected source project, then clone output tables or stream filesystem output datasets into the current branch. Dry run previews the mapping; run mode skips input-only datasets and shared locations, and replaces existing target data only when overwrite is enabled.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run
params.description: Preview dataset mappings without creating or replacing tables or files.

params.name: overwrite_existing
params.label: Overwrite existing datasets
params.description: Replace existing target Snowflake tables or Filesystem data in run mode. Otherwise, skip targets containing tables or files.

params.name: branch_project_key
params.label: Datasets source
params.description: Select the master project or another branch as the source. Datasets are matched by name.
